name: perf01-live
_comment: PERF-01 single-viewer baseline on one clock: start the target with --source live (wall-clock barcode in every frame). 1 protocol viewer plus 2 real-browser viewers; first media, rate, loss, browser first frame / FPS / freezes / capture->display latency and both sides' resources. The browser pages run inline (together with the protocol viewer), as PERF-01 measures one viewer next to the browsers.
